provenance.uncertainty: Specification values are user supplied; actual instrument options, switches, tolerances not stated here, calibration and complete transfer functions are unverified.

each_input_to_ground.value_status: user-provided specification values; actual R/C not measured

between_inputs.interpretation: Equivalent differential impedance of the two equal input-to-ground shunts; do not add an independent parallel 8Mohm/3.5pF branch.

probe.input_model: Two identical 4Mohm parallel 7pF shunts from the two tips to the probe reference ground.
probe.attenuation_reference_load: Nominal voltage conversion for intended high-impedance scope connection; output impedance and calibration are unverified.

scope.physical_connection: Scope input loads the probe output downstream, not the phantom or probe input in parallel.

illustrative_filter_option.scope_model: Assumed unity-DC-gain one-pole low-pass, cutoff 20MHz limit
illustrative_filter_option.status: Illustrative assumption only; bandwidth specifications do not determine actual complex transfer functions.
